title: Dispute Rate by Market Category

axes.name: Share of markets disputed at least once (%)

note: resrisk-v2 · resdb-v2 · flags-v2 · cat-v1 · Category is derived from the question text by keyword because neither venue ships one; every classification records the term that produced it, and roughly 8% land in 'other'. Categories under 100 markets are omitted rather than shown at a rate one dispute could double. Dispute counts are Polymarket/UMA only, on the 58,623 markets that carry a UMA status sequence — Gamma populates it from 2025 onward. Kalshi exposes disputes as a transient market state with no retrospective filter, so its count here is a floor of zero, not a measurement of zero.
